sloka: दृष्ट्वा तु नृपतिः श्रीमानेकचित्तगतम् पुरम् ।निपपातैव दुःखेन हतमूल इव द्रुमः ॥२-४०-३६॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu nṛpatiḥ śrīmānekacittagatam puram ।nipapātaiva duḥkhena hatamūla iva drumaḥ ॥2-40-36॥

translations.english: Having seen the city (people) absorbed in one single thought, the prosperous king, griefstricken, fell down on the ground like a tree severed at its root.
